start.text: Sam Okoro, Dockside Motors. Mind the oil, it gets on everything, including the paperwork.
You've got the look of someone whose parcels keep going the long way round. A van fixes that.

van.text: One white panel van, 140,000 kilometres, ninety-eight hundred dollars. Room for forty parcels or a very patient dog.

honest.text: Straight answer? The gearbox sighs on the hills and the left mirror is held on by hope. The engine is honest, and so am I.
Insure it, keep it moving, and it earns. Leave it on the kerb and it is just a very expensive shed.

end.text: Have a look at the paperwork. Take your time. I'm not going anywhere, I live here.
